subject: STATUS PSO stall: C6l Mali misses are 98.7% fixed_frag (91 misses = 40.2 s of 40.7 s); fix in hand = translator const_loads fold; ETA
body: c6l ui350 log: Mali misses with fs>100 KB (all fixed_vert_lph_spc+fixed_frag_lph_cph, SPIR-V 543-660 KB) = 91 misses / 40199 ms; all other Mali misses 17 / 513 ms. AIR: fixed_frag 26 / 19816 ms, others 2 / 406 ms. Root cause (host-proven): QuartzCore's fixed_frag reads its fc_* switches from a constant state block filled by a static initializer; the pinned translator folds only POINTER loads from constant-global fields, so every case of the uber-shader survives: 528 KB SPIR-V whose live code is ~3 KB. Mali then translates/validates/folds 38K NIR instrs per variant (and each Mali variant key = new full compile). DONE (side copy, not yet in tree): translator patch gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/translator-const-loads-fold.patch (const_loads.rs only, ~25 code lines): fold loads of any type from fields of never-written constant globals (SCCP already does this for whole-global loads). Host results: fixed_frag SPIR-V 528008->3372 B; per fixed_frag pair (AIR+Mali) ~200 ms -> ~30 ms host (6.5x), i.e. device ~0.3+0.34 s -> est. 50-60 ms per miss; other pipelines unchanged (15/17 c6jb Mali binaries byte-identical; fixed_frag final NIR equal modulo SSA names, dropped unused UBO/SSBO decls, and no SignedZeroInfNanPreserve forced by dead cases). air bridge cargo tests 34/34; function-constant census (325 variants) 0 status/refusal/code-size/binding changes; all-family census (3459 variants, base vs fold) running now, ~60 min. Also: per-process Device cache (air_bridge.rs, -15% per normal pipeline and per pack/disk deserialize) patch ready. NIR validation (debugoptimized) is only ~8% after the fold: release Mesa NOT needed (and -DNDEBUG turns Mesa unreachable() into UB), so I do not recommend it. Generic-variant+background swap: NOT exact for fixed_frag (fc_* constants change outputs/bindings/blend, so a generic pipeline is not interface-compatible) and unnecessary once each miss is ~50 ms; translate-once with OpSpecConstant = translator redesign, also unnecessary. PLAN/ETA: (1) now: apply the const_loads patch to the pin (references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin, one file) + the Device cache to air_bridge.rs - I take both unless you object within ~15 min; (2) translator crate tests on the copy (+ golden hash re-bless list) and all-family census diff: ~1.5 h under the thermal lease; (3) host gates + rebuild of host cdylib and iOS Rust archive (build_native_compilers.py air, jobs1) ~30-40 min: candidate-ready in ~2-2.5 h. Pack entries keyed on the old translator identity will be invalidated once (packs need a rebuild).
